\"Story Points\" > 5 AND space = ABC ORD.text:
SELECT i.id FROM fs_side.item i
WHERE i.space_id = ANY($1::int[])
  AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fs_side.v_number v WHERE v.item_id = i.id AND v.field_id = $2 AND v.value > $3::numeric) AND i.space_id = $4::int)
ORDER BY (SELECT v.value FROM fs_side.v_number v WHERE v.item_id = i.id AND v.field_id = $5 LIMIT 1) DESC NULLS LAST, i.id DESC
LIMIT $6

\"Story Points\" IS EMPTY AND type IN (S.text:
SELECT i.id FROM fs_side.item i
WHERE i.space_id = ANY($1::int[])
  AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fs_side.v_number v WHERE v.item_id = i.id AND v.field_id = $2) AND i.type = ANY($3::text[]) AND i.space_id = $4::int)
ORDER BY i.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, i.id DESC
LIMIT $5

(assignee = currentUser() OR reporter =.text:
SELECT i.id FROM fs_side.item i
WHERE i.space_id = ANY($1::int[])
  AND ((i.assignee_id = $2::int OR i.reporter_id = $3::int) AND i.status_category != $4::text)
ORDER BY i.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, i.id DESC
LIMIT $5

Components IN (Alpha, Beta) AND status !.text:
SELECT i.id FROM fs_side.item i
WHERE i.space_id = ANY($1::int[])
  AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fs_side.v_option v WHERE v.item_id = i.id AND v.field_id = $2 AND v.value = ANY($3::text[])) AND i.status != $4::text)
ORDER BY i.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, i.id DESC
LIMIT $5

Due <= endOfMonth() AND Due >= startOfMo.text:
SELECT i.id FROM fs_side.item i
WHERE i.space_id = ANY($1::int[])
  AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fs_side.v_date v WHERE v.item_id = i.id AND v.field_id = $2 AND v.value <= $3::date) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fs_side.v_date v WHERE v.item_id = i.id AND v.field_id = $4 AND v.value >= $5::date))
ORDER BY (SELECT v.value FROM fs_side.v_date v WHERE v.item_id = i.id AND v.field_id = $6 LIMIT 1) ASC NULLS LAST, i.id DESC
LIMIT $7

NOT (labels IN (infra) OR type = Subtask.text:
SELECT i.id FROM fs_side.item i
WHERE i.space_id = ANY($1::int[])
  AND (NOT (i.labels && $2::text[] OR i.type = $3::text) AND i.space_id = ANY($4::numeric[]))
ORDER BY i.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, i.id DESC
LIMIT $5

Owner = currentUser() ORDER BY updated D.text:

ORDER BY i.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, i.id DESC
LIMIT $4

Team = \"Option 3\" AND statusCategory =.text:
SELECT i.id FROM fs_side.item i
WHERE i.space_id = ANY($1::int[])
  AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fs_side.v_option v WHERE v.item_id = i.id AND v.field_id = $2 AND v.value = $3::text) AND i.status_category = $4::text)

assignee = currentUser() AND statusCateg.text:
SELECT i.id FROM fs_side.item i
WHERE i.space_id = ANY($1::int[])
  AND (i.assignee_id = $2::int AND i.status_category != $3::text)

assignee CHANGED BY 42 DURING (2026-01-0.text:

WHERE i.space_id = ANY($1::int[])
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gen.history h WHERE h.item_id = i.id AND h.field = $2 AND h.actor_id = ANY($3::int[]) AND h.at >= $4::timestamptz AND h.at < $5::timestamptz)
ORDER BY i.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, i.id DESC

created >= -30d AND type = Bug ORDER BY.text:

labels IN (security, regression) ORDER B.text:

parent = 12345 ORDER BY created ASC.text:

summary ~ \"login\" ORDER BY created DES.text:

WHERE i.space_id = ANY($1::int[])
  AND to_tsvector('simple', i.summary) @@ plainto_tsquery('simple', $2)

LIMIT $3
